'''Garnik''' was a war hero of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] well before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the Cold War, the Republic named the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Avilatan]], an island on Ord Mantell, [[Fort Garnik]] in Garnik's honor as they established a military garrison there.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garnik was mentioned in the Codex entry for Fort Garnik in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
